title: mimid-agent: take a newer did:webvh log without a restart
description: Since bead mimid-1wgh.4.81.18 the daemon reads [did_webvh].log_file only at start (Agent::open), and Agent::use_did_webvh_credential is the library API. A running daemon should notice the controller writing a newer log (or offer a local endpoint to hand it one) and offer it to its rooms. Also: when the Commit carrying it cannot be made (a pending GroupContextExtensions proposal, Open Issue 5), fall back to Member::propose_credential_update so another member commits it.
notes: Decided by Mark 2026-11-17: both. A local authenticated 'apply this log' endpoint on the agent (loopback, the agent's token) as the main path, plus watching [did_webvh].log_file; one shared check path; fall back to Member::propose_credential_update when the agent cannot commit (pending GCE, Open Issue 5).
